name: Voxel Carving
definition: A technique to carve a voxel grid from a number of depth maps or silhouettes. It creates a dense, filled voxel grid of the given shape, unlike surface-only voxelization.
summary: Voxel carving reconstructs a dense 3D volume from 2D silhouettes by filling interior space, distinguishing itself from surface-only methods by ensuring volumetric consistency across multiple views.
